signs.text: ST HERBERT'S ISLAND. A hermit named Herbert lived on an island in Derwentwater in the 600s. Bede wrote that he prayed to die on the same day as his friend Cuthbert of Lindisfarne, and in 687 he did.

text: A narrow bed of stones, a ledge for a candle, and a window the size of a book. It is quiet in a way that costs money elsewhere.
